grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: Weekend Plans and Past Activities
instructions: 这是模拟练习材料，不是官方雅思考试。听录音前先读题。录音会播放两遍。根据录音内容回答问题。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过字数限制。所有问题均为单选题或填空题。
transcript: A: Hi, Mei. How was your weekend? B: It was good, thanks. I was at home on Saturday. A: Were you busy? B: No, I wasn't. I was very lazy. I watched TV. A: What did you watch? B: A comedy. It was funny. A: Nice. What are you going to do next weekend? B: I'm going to visit my sister. She lives in Shanghai. A: How are you going to go? B: I'm going to take the train. A: Why? B: Because it's fast and cheap. A: What time is your train? B: It's at eight in the morning. A: Are you going to stay long? B: No, just two days. I'm going to come back on Sunday evening. A: That sounds good. Have a nice trip! B: Thanks!

grammar.title: Past tense 'was/were' and 'be going to'
grammar.explanation: 我们用 was/were 谈论过去。I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。否定形式：was not (wasn't), were not (weren't)。我们用 be going to 谈论计划。结构：am/is/are + going to + 动词原形。
grammar.example: I was at home on Saturday. I'm going to visit my sister.

questions.explanation: 主语 I 的过去时用 was。
questions.evidence: I was at home on Saturday.

questions.explanation: 主语 She 的过去时用 was。
主语 They 的过去时用 were。

options: I am going to visit my sister.
I going to visit my sister.
I am go to visit my sister.
answers: I am going to visit my sister.
questions.explanation: be going to 结构：am + going to + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: I'm going to visit my sister.
